mapper.select: /* BmsMobBwisMapper.selectInspectResult : 검사대상확인 - 검사대상 조회 */ SELECT TBI.BL_NO , SUBSTRING(TBI.CARRYIN_DATE,3,8) AS CARRYIN_DATE , TBI.CT , ISNULL(TIR.INSPECTION_FINISH_YN,'') AS INSPECTION_FINISH_YN , (SELECT NAME_DEFAULT FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = #{srchEntCode} AND GROUP_CODE = 'SE_INSPECTION_CODE' AND CODE = TIR.SE_INSPECTION_CODE) AS SE_INSPECTION_CODE , (SELECT NAME_DEFAULT FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = #{srchEntCode} AND GROUP_CODE = 'INSPECTION_TYPE' AND CODE = TIR.INSPECTION_TYPE) AS INSPECTION_TYPE , (SELECT NAME_DEFAULT FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = #{srchEntCode} AND GROUP_CODE = 'INSPECTION_TYPE' AND CODE = TIR.INSPECTION_TYPE_A) AS INSPECTION_TYPE_A , (SELECT NAME_DEFAULT FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = #{srchEntCode} AND GROUP_CODE = 'INSPECTION_TYPE' AND CODE = TIR.INSPECTION_TYPE_B) AS INSPECTION_TYPE_B , (SELECT NAME_DEFAULT FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = #{srchEntCode} AND GROUP_CODE = 'SE_INSPECTION_CODE' AND CODE = TIR.XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE) AS XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE , (SELECT NAME_DEFAULT FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = #{srchEntCode} AND GROUP_CODE = 'SE_INSPECTION_CODE' AND CODE = TIR.PALN5EM_INSPECTION_CODE) AS PALN5EM_INSPECTION_CODE , ISNULL(TIR.TIC_OUT_SCAN_USER_ID, '') AS TIC_OUT_SCAN_USER_ID FROM TB_BMS_IN TBI WITH (NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN TB_BMS_LOCAL_INSPECT_RESULT TIR ON TBI.IN_NO = TIR.IN_NO WHERE TBI.IN_NO = #{srchNo}
